note: Every value here was read from the guidelines PDF by hand. Pages are PDF page numbers (printed page + 1). Re-verify all values and pages whenever a new PDF version is loaded, then update verified_version.

weight_note.text: The Handtevy resuscitation system is the approved reference for pediatric resuscitation. A length-based resuscitation tape may be utilized for pediatric weight estimation.

max_adult.text: Pediatric medication dosages should not exceed maximum single or total adult dose.

equipment.text: ETT size: (Age + 16) / 4. Subtract 0.5 for cuffed ETT. NG/OG/Foley size: 2x ETT size. ETT depth: 3x ETT size. Chest tube: 4x ETT size.

maintenance.text: <10 kg: 4 mL/kg. 10 – 20 kg: 40 mL + 2 mL/kg for every kg > 10. >20 kg: 60 + 1 mL/kg for every kg > 20 kg.

sbp.text: Normal SBP, children < 10 years: > 90 + (age x2) mmHg. Hemorrhagic shock, children < 10 years: SBP > 80 mmHg or presence of a brachial pulse. Head injury, children < 10 years: SBP > 90 + (age x2) mmHg.

defib.text: First shock 2 J/kg. Second shock 4 J/kg. Subsequent shocks ≥ 4 J/kg, maximum 10 J/kg or adult dose.

pads.text: If ≤ 10 kg, utilize infant/pediatric pads. If > 10 kg, utilize adult/child pads. The displayed joule setting in Handtevy may not exactly match the calculated dose (rounded to selectable Zoll X-Series levels).

cardioversion.text: Synchronized cardioversion: begin with 0.5-1 J/kg; if not effective, increase to 2 J/kg.

fluids.text: Hypovolemic & Hemorrhagic Shock: NS/LR 20 mL/kg boluses; 10 mL/kg boluses for neonates to a max of 30 mL/kg.
Sepsis: NS/LR 20 mL/kg to maintain an SBP of 90 + (age x2); 10 mL/kg boluses for neonates to a max of 30 mL/kg.
